slices.title: Live-verify and fix the four read sources (code half)
slices.summary: On dedicated OD12 accounts, proves each of the four read sources (mail, calendar, drive, sharepoint listing) for both providers through a Do run and an Ask turn on the delegated user token, and fixes the helpers the plan lists as unverified (Graph search and ordering, nextLink, Drive corpora). Live responses become redacted fixtures, and the CHAT_GAP status rows record dated results.

slices.title: Owner read knowledge.list_documents in Do
slices.summary: Adds the owner read knowledge.list_documents to the Do loop: a new owner_reads.rs calls Data Plane DocumentService ListDocuments with the run's delegated user bearer (the same bearer execute_knowledge_search uses) and returns at most 25 rows of document_id, title, source, type and status with no content. It is offered only when MODEL_ACTION_ADMISSION=table, the admission row is enabled and the run is not ZDR. The model-access row gains its do executor and the contract is regenerated in every copy.
